name: Total Wine & More Receipt
description: This receipt format originates from Total Wine & More, a U.S. specialty retail chain focused on wine, spirits, and beverage sales. The receipt header displays the Total Wine & More branding, followed by the store identification 2101 – Total Wine – Paddock Shops and the physical location 4320 Summit Plaza Drive #5, Louisville, Kentucky 40241. The POS section includes operational metadata such as ticket number, transaction time, date, store number, register number, and cashier identifier. A structured transaction table lists items with columns for quantity, price, and amount, followed by a financial summary including subtotal, tax, total, payment method, and change. The lower portion of the receipt contains customer engagement messages promoting the &More rewards program and survey participation, along with a barcode and barcode number, and concludes with the Customer Copy designation. The format is typical of U.S. alcohol and beverage retail POS systems with survey and loyalty program integration.
